Name: Kenneth's Vegetable Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Vegetable Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds 172 vegetables to Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- 172 vegetables like Baby Bok Choy Bunch, Birds Eye Chili, Broccoli Floret, Broccoli Head, Brown Shallot, Butternut Squash, Celery Stalk, Chard Leaves and many more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Includes gourds, green beans, hop cones, kale, leeks, lettuce, chili peppers, rhubarb, acorn squash, butternut squash and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Single items, bunches, piles and bowls[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Building with 5 shop variants and portraits[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Every vegetable can be turned on or off in GMCM[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All vegetables are sold in Kenneth's Vegetable Shop building. The building has 5 shops inside.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Building Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm, Kenneth's Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for toggling vegetables[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
